about: What the real pose tracker reported for test/fixtures/body/stands.webm, 15 times a second: a rendered person standing on one leg. From 1 to 9 seconds their right foot goes up evenly from the floor to 48 centimetres, (t - 1) * 6 centimetres, with the knee coming forward, and from 10 to 18 seconds their left foot does the same. Then the right foot goes up 30 centimetres from 20 to 21 seconds and is held until 24.5 and down by 25.5, the left the same from 26.5 to 27.5, held until 31 and down by 32, and the right is lifted 8 centimetres from 34 to 36. Their nose is about 1.25 metres off the floor. Only the nose and the ankles are kept: each is [x, y, z, how sure], as shares of the picture, which is not mirrored.
